verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own Brain² is documented as answering complex questions by checking the user's workspace (tasks, docs, conversations), apps and the web, which covers the core ask-and-answer part of the story. Nothing in the evidence says answers include citations or source links back to workspace content, and there is no hands-on corroboration of speed or accuracy. missing for 10: documented citations/source attribution in answers, evidence of instant response, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content

citations.quote: Ask something complex. Brain² checks your workspace, apps, and the web for answers.
Brain² sees your tasks, docs, and conversations.
Brain² taps Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce, and more to get you answers and insights.
